title: Answer: animals with controlled attention, and machines that model it

statements.text: Components of consciousness are likely present in many mammals, birds and nonavian reptiles, not in a human-like form. A machine with a model of its attention would claim consciousness, and a simple agent with a schema is conscious only in a simple sense.

sources.quote: I am not suggesting that all of these animals are conscious in a human-like manner, but some of the same mechanisms are likely to be present.
